QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] Continental Conference
QuestInfo.1: Claudine has made an important decision that will affect the fate of the Resistance. She wants to tell you firsthand.
QuestInfo.2: The tides of Maple World are changing. The Resistance and the Cygnus Knights have joined forces, years after their old relationship went sour. Will this Alliance be enough to defeat the Black Mage?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Can proceed to The Birth of an Alliance\r\n

0.0: I hope your training is going well. Your transition into Maple World hasn't been easy, but you've handled yourself better than anyone I've ever seen. You've been a big part of the Resistance, and I think you deserve to know: we've just made a very big decision.\r\n#b(If you accept, you will move to the Secret Plaza.)

0.msg: While you were out, the Cygnus Knights reached out and invited us to what they're calling a Continental Conference. They told us they want to form an alliance to stand united against the Black Mage.

2.msg: There was much debate, but we've decided, as a group, to attend the conference. We may not all be friends, but against a threat like the Black Mage, we can't afford to turn down good help. Hmph, maybe we'll even end up trusting each other again.

4.msg: It was not an easy choice to make, but we can't have progress without any change. Which brings us to you. What do you think about the decision, as an ex-Black Mage commander?

5.msg: #bIn the past, Maple World was segregated, siloed off into bickering kingdoms and tribes. But any one kingdom can fall. We can't afford to ignore one another anymore. We have to join hands and fight!

6.msg: #bComparatively speaking, the Black Mage is like a fallen Transcendent, possessing god-like powers. And he's granted some of that strength to his subordinates, making them nearly as powerful as he is.

yes.0: I'm glad you agree. It lifts a weight of my mind. The real battle is coming, and we're going to need your support. On that note, would you like to join me at the Continental Conference?
